Primavera P6

Oracle Primavera P6 supports enterprise project scheduling, resources and portfolio controls.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a logic-linked schedule

Use the approved project dataset, calendar and reporting grain. In the intended Primavera P6 preview, build a logic-linked schedule; the visible result is a structured planning or reporting view with source fields visible. Review data ownership, dates, relationships and completeness before accepting or exporting it.

Level resources and update progress

Start from the selected measures, activities, resources or work items. In the intended Primavera P6 preview, level resources and update progress; the visible result is a decision view that exposes status, sequence and capacity. Review definitions, dependencies, resource limits and stale data before accepting or exporting it.

Review forecast and critical path

Begin with the current baseline, progress cut-off and governance rules. In the intended Primavera P6 preview, review forecast and critical path; the visible result is a reviewed forecast, report or delivery board with exceptions visible. Review variance, critical work, blockers and accountable ownership before accepting or exporting it.
